description: Syria Border Crossings is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by U.S. Department of State - Office of the Geographer and Global Issues. Data as of June 11, 2015. The "Syria Border Crossings" dataset contains verified data about the geographic location (point geometry) and name of border crossings for Syria. Compiled by the U.S. Department of State, Humanitarian Information Unit ( each attribute in the dataset is verified against multiple sources. Coverage: Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria. The portal files it under the publisher U.S. Department of State - Office of the Geographer and Global Issues. Its tags are border crossings, geodata, logistics. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, KML, SHP, TSV. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
